mechanism: Pyrazinamide may inhibit hepatic metabolism of amitriptyline and both drugs can cause hepatotoxicity, with pyrazinamide also potentially increasing amitriptyline levels through CYP450 inhibition.
action: Monitor amitriptyline levels and signs of toxicity (anticholinergic effects, cardiac conduction changes); consider amitriptyline dose reduction and monitor hepatic function during concurrent use.
